title: [SPEC] sec 3.3 hash channel formula stale: src_iid^dst_iid vs implemented FNV1a32(eui64+epoch) per 02a 2a.3.1
description: Req R-02-011 (spec 02-physical-link.md:42). DIVERGENT: spec formula data_ch = 1 + (hash(src_iid ^ dst_iid) mod (N_CHANNELS-1)) is implemented nowhere; all three implementations follow spec/02a 2a.3.1: FNV1A32(eui64_be || epoch_le_u32) with density>10 -> CH0 (python/src/lichen/ccp.py:68-115, rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:385-395, C link_ctx.c:722,754 + sync_hop.c), pinned by ccp15.json and ccp_select_channel_endianness.json. Spec fix: rewrite sec 3.3 to match 02a 2a.3.1 and the vectors. Also fix filename typo in the same file: sec 3.4 and 3.5 reference test/vectors/sf-assignment.json but the on-disk file is sf_assignment.json. No code change.
close_reason: Fixed: spec/02-physical-link.md sec 3.3 hash-based channel formula amended from the stale 'src_iid ^ dst_iid' to the correct FNV1A32(EUI64_BE || epoch_LE_u32) formula per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.3.1, matching all three implementations (python ccp.py:68-115, rust rf_health.rs:385-395, C link_ctx.c:722,754 + sync_hop.c) and vectors (ccp15.json, ccp_select_channel_endianness.json). Also added the density > 10 → CH0 fallback annotation. Additionally fixed the filename typo: 'sf-assignment.json' → 'sf_assignment.json' (the actual committed file). No code changes needed — implementations were already correct; this was a spec-text-only fix.
